channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andrew Bynum | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andrew Bynum from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Phil Jackson:

“We had discussed the trade for Pau a season before. My reluctance was that he wasn’t a defensive center and protecting the lane was a priority. However, Andrew Bynum was an important member of the team and allowed Pau to play both positions when the Lakers won back-to-back titles. Pau’s ability to play both positions really made the Lakers a potent offensive team.”

Phil Jackson on Andrew Bynum, Aug 12, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Kevin McHale on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“I liked Andrew Bynum as a player. I liked Al, because he was a better scorer, but when you looked at Bynum, I was just so afraid of his knees and all the stuff that goes with that.“I know what people say about me and Danny, but if you look at what the Celtics (offered), Al and the picks, it was the best of the offers that were out there. I was actually surprised in one way, because there weren’t many teams we could deal with.”

Kevin McHale on Andrew Bynum, Nov 16, 2014. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Kevin McHale on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“The two offers were (Lakers center) Andrew Bynum, and I was afraid of his knees, and Big Al — and then some draft choices and other throw-ins and stuff like that,”

Kevin McHale on Andrew Bynum, Nov 16, 2014. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Andrew Bynum, Phil Jackson, Mike Brown
item.description:
“So, I think it was easier to do when Phil Jackson and his staff was around. Then, when asked if Brown had provided that same culture for Bynum when he coached in Los Angeles, Gasol responded: “Nah. Not the same.”

Pau Gasol on Andrew Bynum, Phil Jackson, Mike Brown, Mar 1, 2014. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Larry Bird on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Bird on perception he signed Bynum to keep him away from Heat:

“That's about the dumbest thing I ever heard. We dont have money like that.”

Larry Bird on Andrew Bynum, Feb 1, 2014. Source: Twitter @NYDNInterNets.

item.title: Larry Bird on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Indiana Pacers:Larry Bird on Bynum:

“We are obviously happy to have him join our team... With the minutes he gets, he should be a valuable addition.”

Larry Bird on Andrew Bynum, Feb 1, 2014. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Anderson Varejao on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“We probably going to be able to run more pick and rolls, to play faster. With Andrew – I mean, he's not gone. He's still part of the team. I don't know really what's going on -- but without him on the court, it seems we play faster,”

Anderson Varejao on Andrew Bynum, Dec 29, 2013. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Scott O'Neil on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
After being urged by 94 WIP-FM personality Angelo Cataldi, new Sixers chief executive officer Scott O’Neil apologized Thursday morning to fans who purchased tickets with the hope of seeing Bynum play.

“I apologize on behalf of the Sixers to any fan who invested and thought Bynum was going to be their guy and be the savior,”

Scott O'Neil on Andrew Bynum, Jul 25, 2013. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Jason Lloyd:Tristan Thompson on #Cavs signing Bynum:

“He’s an All-Star. Having him healthy is going to help us a lot...you can never have enough bigs.”

Tristan Thompson on Andrew Bynum, Jul 18, 2013. Source: Twitter @JasonLloydABJ.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Bynum did not receive an enthusiastic endorsement from new general manager and president Sam Hinkie at his introductory press conference in May.

“I think of Andrew like the thousands of other young men walking around the world that are unrestricted free agents that have potential to play NBA basketball,”

Sam Hinkie on Andrew Bynum, Jun 25, 2013. Source: Associated Press.

item.title: Rod Thorn on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Rod Thorn:

“With the (Andrew) Bynum situation, we gave up some terrific assets in order to get Andrew. And Andrew hasn't been able to play. So I think we played about as well as we could play otherwise. I think we have done some good things. We had a bad stretch in the year. Obviously, we are finishing up here on a pretty high note. But we rolled the dice to so speak with Bynum. I think if we had Bynum, we'd be a really good team. And with him not being able to play, it's been a tough thing for us.”

Rod Thorn on Andrew Bynum, Apr 1, 2013. Source: Delaware County Daily Times.

item.title: Tony DiLeo on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Christopher A. Vito:Sixers GM Tony DiLeo on Andrew Bynum:

“Now he has to make a decision, the doctors have to make a (decision) – what’s the next, best step?”

Tony DiLeo on Andrew Bynum, Mar 3, 2013. Source: Twitter @ChrisVito.

item.title: Doug Collins on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Sixers coach Doug Collins said.

“We have not had Andrew [Bynum] all year and we are going to miss Jrue some.”

Doug Collins on Andrew Bynum, Dec 19, 2012. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Doug Collins on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“We knew that. Giving him up, we thought we were going to have one of the best post defenders (Bynum).”

Doug Collins on Andrew Bynum, Dec 9, 2012. Source: phillyburbs.com.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
It was a question Lakers general manager Mitch Kupchak had to answer over the summer before he made the trade that sent Bynum to Philadelphia in a four-team deal that brought Howard to Los Angeles from Orlando.

“Whatever concern we had (with Bynum's knees) was offset by Dwight coming off offseason back surgery,”

Mitch Kupchak on Andrew Bynum, Oct 17, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rod Thorn on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
#SixersRod Thorn on WIP:

“(Bynum will) be a focal point of what we do. He never was a focal point with the Lakers.”

Rod Thorn on Andrew Bynum, Aug 15, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rod Thorn on Andre Iguodala, Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Rod Thorn on how they pulled off the trade for Andrew Bynum:

“It’s interesting in that we’ve been talking to the Lakers and to Orlando for the last three weeks. We’ve been talking about different deals, various deals, and it never got out. In today’s world that’s something of itself. And then it really came down to, Orlando — they did not want to keep Iguodala because they’re going in a different way. And they wanted to move him, and so they talked to a few teams and they ended up making the deal with Denver to move his contract, and that ended up making the deal. It took a while to do it but it ended up getting done.”

Rod Thorn on Andre Iguodala, Andrew Bynum, Aug 13, 2012. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Rod Thorn on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Rod Thorn on the potential for a long-term extension for Bynum in Philadelphia:

“Over the course of the season, if he’s happy and he’s healthy, we’ll certainly do everything we can do re-sign him. And we certainly are in the driver’s seat because we can give him an extra year and obviously more money. But to me, if he’s happy, he’s going to want to sign here. So I think it was a risk, anything you do there’s a risk. But if you’re going to take a risk, always take it on somebody who could be a special player.”

Rod Thorn on Andrew Bynum, Aug 13, 2012. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Tom Moore:Reggie Miller on #Sixers Andrew Bynum:

“(I expect) an all-star year. He always wanted to be the focus of a team and now he has a chance.”

Reggie Miller on Andrew Bynum, Aug 11, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Doug Collins on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“Andrew Bynum can rebound and block shots, which is something we desperately needed and Jason Richardson adds another great shooter to our lineup so I’m very excited,”

Doug Collins on Andrew Bynum, Aug 10, 2012. Source: CSNPhilly.com.

item.title: Josh Harris on Andrew Bynum, Jason Richardson
item.description:
“We are very excited to welcome Andrew Bynum, one of the league's best, young centers, and Jason Richardson, a proven, respected veteran, to the Philadelphia 76ers,”

Josh Harris on Andrew Bynum, Jason Richardson, Aug 10, 2012. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jim Buss on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Jim Buss on Andrew Bynum:

“I've been obviously a big fan of Andrew's ... we're looking forward to a full, solid year with him.”

Jim Buss on Andrew Bynum, Jul 17, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Phil Jackson:

“Andrew is All-Star center. He was-- did a wonderful job. But, you know, it-- what happened was, it took Pau out of his game. And it took the team away from some of their game. So they changed the style dramatically.”

Phil Jackson on Andrew Bynum, Jun 19, 2012. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Phil Jackson:

“Jim saw Andrew as a kid and thought Bynum was going to be a great pick for our team. But in the process I think he’s wanted to have Andrew to have a bigger and bigger role, and I think he’s hired his coach to have Andrew have a bigger and bigger role. And that kind of disjointed the symmetry of what the Lakers were really about this last year. Andrew is an All-Star Center and he did a wonderful job. But what happened was it took Pau out of his game and it took the team away from some of their game. So they changed the style dramatically.”

Phil Jackson on Andrew Bynum, Jun 19, 2012. Source: SheridanHoops.

item.title: Jim Buss on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Jim Buss:

“I think it’s pretty obvious how I feel about Andrew Bynum. He’s an incredible All-Star center and you can build the future around him.”

Jim Buss on Andrew Bynum, Jun 1, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“I don't have any complaints with Andrew. He's averaging (18.2) points per game and (12.2) rebounds. If you look at his first four years here, I don't think he came anywhere near that production. I think he's doing fine. I think he's flourishing in what we have planned for him.”

Mike Brown on Andrew Bynum, Mar 30, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“Andrew. Pau. And myself. Those are three bona fide All-Stars. And you’d put that against anyone else’s three? “Yes, I would.”

Kobe Bryant on Andrew Bynum, Jan 10, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
“If Andrew can stay healthy and do that on a consistent basis, I'm telling you, we'd have a nice little three-headed monster,”

Kobe Bryant on Andrew Bynum, Jan 1, 2012. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Mike Brown on Andrew Bynum
item.description:
Mike Brown was so appropriately intent on crediting memorable hustle plays by Derek Fisher and Steve Blake that he didn't even mention Bynum in his postgame opening remarks.

“I am fine with Andrew, I expect him to play well, but that's not why we won the game,”

Mike Brown on Andrew Bynum, Jan 1, 2012. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Jim Buss on Andrew Bynum, Dwight Howard
item.description:
(Jim Buss) says.

“You'd have to be kind of silly to give up two All-Stars like that for Howard. Zero truth to it. We have never been asked for Andrew and Pau and we've never offered them. I think they know we'd either say no or they would sound crazy for asking.”

Jim Buss on Andrew Bynum, Dwight Howard, Dec 25, 2011. Source: Los Angeles Times.
